WITH copd_exac_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (257004,4115044,44807895,43530693,46270376,35208024)
  UNION SELECT 257004 UNION SELECT 4115044 UNION SELECT 44807895 UNION SELECT 43530693 UNION SELECT 46270376 UNION SELECT 35208024
),
maintenance AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
         CASE
           WHEN (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%budesonide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fluticasone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mometasone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beclomethasone%')
             THEN 'ICS-inclusive'
           WHEN (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tiotropium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%umeclidinium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyr%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aclidinium%')
            AND (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%salmeterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%formoterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%vilanterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%indacaterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%olodaterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%arformoterol%')
             THEN 'LABA/LAMA'
         END AS approach,
         c.concept_name
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE (LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%inhal%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%actuat%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%dry powder%')
    AND (
      LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%tiotropium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%umeclidinium%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%glycopyr%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aclidinium%' OR
      LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%salmeterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%formoterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%vilanterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%indacaterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%olodaterol%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%arformoterol%' OR
      LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%budesonide%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%fluticasone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%mometasone%' OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beclomethasone%'
    )
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT m.person_id, m.index_date, m.approach,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.person_id ORDER BY m.index_date) AS rn
  FROM maintenance m
  WHERE m.approach IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN copd_exac_concepts ec ON ec.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
         WHERE co.person_id=m.person_id AND co.condition_start_date >= DATEADD(day,-365,m.index_date) AND co.condition_start_date < m.index_date) >= 2
),
index_cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id,index_date,approach FROM eligible WHERE rn=1
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT ic.person_id, ic.approach,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.condition_occurrence co JOIN copd_exac_concepts ec ON ec.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
           JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON vo.visit_occurrence_id=co.visit_occurrence_id
           WHERE co.person_id=ic.person_id
             AND co.condition_start_date > ic.index_date AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,ic.index_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_exac_visit
  FROM index_cohort ic
)
SELECT approach, COUNT(*) AS n_patients, SUM(had_exac_visit) AS n_with_12mo_exac_visit,
       CAST(1.0*SUM(had_exac_visit)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS proportion
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY approach
ORDER BY approach

WITH maint0 AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS index_date,
         CASE
           WHEN de.drug_concept_id IN (42708516,40169281,42708514,40169269,40169285,40169232,40169236,46276023,46234373,40169218,43531861,46276021,1593825,1593834,1361703,1593840,37002842,37002848,792493,37003604,37003577) THEN 'ICS-inclusive'
           WHEN de.drug_concept_id IN (44785540,35605107,790206,42629523,37499737) THEN 'LABA/LAMA'
         END AS approach
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  WHERE de.drug_concept_id IN (42708516,40169281,42708514,40169269,40169285,40169232,40169236,46276023,46234373,40169218,43531861,46276021,1593825,1593834,1361703,1593840,37002842,37002848,792493,37003604,37003577,44785540,35605107,790206,42629523,37499737)
),
first_maint AS (
  SELECT person_id, index_date, approach,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY person_id ORDER BY index_date) AS rn
  FROM maint0
  WHERE approach IS NOT NULL
),
index_cohort AS (
  SELECT person_id, index_date, approach FROM first_maint WHERE rn=1
),
frequent AS (
  SELECT ic.person_id, ic.index_date, ic.approach
  FROM index_cohort ic
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id=ic.person_id
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (257004,46270376,43530693)
   AND co.condition_start_date >= DATEADD(day,-365,ic.index_date)
   AND co.condition_start_date < ic.index_date
  GROUP BY ic.person_id, ic.index_date, ic.approach
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.condition_occurrence_id) >= 2
),
follow AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.approach,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT co.condition_occurrence_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS had_12mo_exac_visit
  FROM frequent f
  LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id=f.person_id
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (257004,46270376,43530693)
   AND co.condition_start_date > f.index_date
   AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,365,f.index_date)
   AND co.visit_occurrence_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY f.person_id, f.approach
)
SELECT approach, COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(had_12mo_exac_visit) AS n_with_12mo_exac_visit,
       CAST(1.0*SUM(had_12mo_exac_visit)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,4)) AS proportion
FROM follow
GROUP BY approach
ORDER BY proportion ASC

- **Chemokine signaling** and neutrophil-recruitment biology, especially `CXCL8`
- **Complement system** and neutrophil-associated genes such as `ELANE`

Mechanistically, this pattern is consistent with many frequent COPD exacerbators having **neutrophilic/innate immune inflammation**—TLR → NF-κB → IL-1β/TNF/IL-6/CXCL8—where bronchodilator-focused LABA/LAMA may perform comparably or slightly better than ICS-inclusive therapy. ICS may be more helpful in a **type-2/eosinophilic** COPD subgroup, but less so in neutrophilic/infective phenotypes and may add infection/pneumonia susceptibility.
